narr: A strengthening low-pressure system moving across the Florida Keys brought widespread heavy rainfall to much of South Florida throughout the day on March 22nd, leading to localized flooding.
ev: Law enforcement reported flash flooding with several stalled-out cars and standing water on Southern Boulevard in West Palm Beach, as well as US-1 in Lake Worth, after rounds of showers and thunderstorms moved through the area. 3 to 5 inches of rain was estimated to have fallen in a less than 3-hour period across this area, with 12-hour rainfall amounts of 6 to 7 inches.
lsr: Law enforcement reported via social media flash flooding on Southern Blvd near Washington Rd. 4 cars are stalled out in high waters.
